name: Front stage and backstage, cut by one line
useWhen: Two halves of an operation — what the client sees and what runs underneath — have to read as ONE system rather than two, and the deck can afford a slide that commits the whole canvas to saying so.

focal.note: Diameter against headline size. The hub is the largest object and the only one belonging to neither zone — which is what makes it read as the join rather than a third thing.

replacesNote: The strongest compositional device in the selection and the kit has nothing near it. enum-numbered-4 uses .slide--ground for a partial change under a numeral row; this is the same idea at full canvas scale.

deviations.source: headline prints through its own paragraph
